company60: Analytics software for operations teams at mid-size companies; about 900 people (sample: Acme is made up).
This role owns positioning and launches for Acme Analytics, the fastest-growing product line.
Two to three launches a year, plus battlecards and win/loss work for sales.
Why now: a new add-on family is coming.
pitch: I'm a product marketer with eight years in B2B software. At Northwind Software I lead launches for our analytics add-on, Insights, which reached 1,200 paying accounts in two quarters, and I run the battlecard program our 40 account executives use. Before that I spent four years at Globex Analytics, where I learned to test messaging with real numbers. I'm looking for a senior role where I own positioning for an analytics product end to end, which is what this role is.
why: Acme Analytics is the kind of product I've launched before, and this role owns it end to end.

map.q: Tell me about a launch you're proud of.
How do you make sure sales uses what you build?
Tell me about a disagreement with another team.
Have you worked with usage-based pricing?

weak.gap: The posting asks for usage-based pricing experience
weak.answer: Say no plainly, then the Globex pricing page test (+18% demo requests) and how you'd learn the model in the first 90 days.

ask: What does success look like in the first 90 days?
How do product marketing and sales plan a launch together here?
What's the biggest positioning question the team is working on now?
comp: If pay comes up: the posted range is $140,000 to $165,000 base; I'm looking at $150,000 to $160,000 depending on the full package.
logistics: Test your camera, mic and the link the day before
Log in 10 minutes early with water and these notes
Have your resume and the job posting open in another tab
Send thank-you notes within 24 hours (ask your assistant to draft them)
